Receiving your dispute regarding the account ACC-528361, we acknowledge your assertion that the debt is not yours. We have reviewed the account information and confirm that the original creditor is Lakeshore Utilities. The current balance on the account is $1,718.30. We also note that the charge-off date was December 18, 2023, and the last payment date was July 18, 2025.

In accordance with the FDCPA, we are required to provide you with validation of the debt if you dispute it. However, you have indicated that you do not have documents to provide. We will investigate the matter further and attempt to verify the debt through other means.

Please be advised that we will not cease collection efforts at this time. However, we will continue to investigate your dispute and provide any additional information or documentation that we may obtain.

You have the right to dispute this debt further and may request that we verify the debt through a written request. Please note that you may also contact the original creditor, Lakeshore Utilities, to discuss this matter.

Sincerely,

Bridgeport Recovery Inc.
